actions: Remove visible ticks carefully
Treat with an appropriate tick control product
Check other animals in the herd/flock for ticks
warning_signs: Large areas of hair loss or skin damage
Fever or lethargy following tick exposure
recommendation: Heavy infestations can spread disease and cause anemia - treat promptly and consult a vet if the animal seems unwell.
follow_up_questions: How many ticks are visible?
Is the animal showing signs of weakness or paleness?
Are other animals in the herd affected too?
